name: University
description: Here you can find basically most of the exercises I'm solving during my University journey. This repo will contain lots of folders inside of it, each of one related to one subject. It won't be limited to one language.

name: ShellcodeStringTool
description: 一个字符串转换工具，主要用于在shellcode开发中，将双引号字符串转为单引号形式，比如："123"转为'1','2','3'

name: PyLineShell
description: 基于Python3的Shell Payload库，针对于渗透测试中拿到exec、pickle等命令执行点后不落地内存加载Py代码、无落地直接运行Py项目、无回显不出网等场景

name: Shellcode2Words
description: A tool that converts shellcode randomly using a dictionary!

name: PowerDecode
description: PowerDecode is a PowerShell-based tool that allows to deobfuscate PowerShell scripts obfuscated across multiple layers. The tool performs code dynamic analysis, extracting malware hosting URLs and checking http response.It can also detect if the malware attempts to inject shellcode into memory.

name: NetRunners
description: Reflective shellcode runners using obfuscated Win32 APIs in C# and C++

name: Shellcode-Obfuscator
description: Python tool for shellcode evasion by fragmenting and filling it with customisable decoy data, generating obfuscated C source code to be compiled.

name: Jigsaw
description: Hide shellcode by shuffling bytes into a random array and reconstruct at runtime

name: Practica-CWE-121-Shellcode
description: Esta práctica tiene como finalidad el de ejemplificar la vulnerabilidad de la OWASP cwe-121 pero hecho en shellcode
